Advances: specled.triangulation

Three advisory findings from the specled_-ygi cold verification (VERIFY comment 2026-07-26T01:15:21Z on specled_-ygi), none blocking, all v1-lane polish:

1. binding_present? clause of specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity is pinned on only one of the two producers. Reverting mix spec.triangle's binding_present? line to file-based breaks no test: spec_triangle_test.exs's out-of-repo case drives the missing-artifact path only, never an aggregate envelope, so the MFA-level untested gate (coverage_triangulation.ex:986) is unexercised through that producer. Add an aggregate-envelope case to spec_triangle_test.exs with an out-of-repo-only binding asserting branch_guard_untested_realization still fires.

2. binding_present? (now closure_mfas != []) is also true when Code.ensure_loaded fails for every closure module — previously false. Arguably correct (unloadable binding = dangling-binding concern, not missing-test evidence) but the requirement statement only speaks of out-of-repo sources. Extend the specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity statement to state the unloadable-module posture explicitly.

3. .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:28 still reads "The v1 functions and mix spec.triangle are unchanged" — scoped to the v2-addition paragraph and true historically, but now contradicted as a standing claim by the v1_file_level_path_identity requirement. Reword to past tense ("the v2 addition left ... unchanged").

Origin: specled_-ygi pipeline (implementer session 141a62c8-2350-4ae5-99f3-bd2ca8af46fd). Standalone: does not block the dn4 epic.

ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27)
Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98).

VERDICT: still_applicable   EFFORT: small

== MANDATE AS ADMITTED (implement THIS, not the original description) ==
Three sub-items; item 1 must be re-scoped because its stated remedy is impossible.

(1) REPLACE the ticket's prescribed test with one of these (implementer picks; recommend 1a + 1b):
  1a. Fix the false comment at lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:431-435. End state: the comment states the truth — the field is MFA-based so the closure map matches the shape `SpecLedEx.CoverageTriangulation` consumers expect (coverage_triangulation.ex:579, :986), and note that this task's own rendering paths currently never read it (aggregate findings are filtered to `detector_unavailable` at spec.triangle.ex:376). Do NOT keep the sentence "the MFA-level untested-realization gate reads this and must keep flagging it".
  1b. Pin the producer at the unit level instead of through the task: add a test to test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs (or a new aggregate case in test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs that calls `CoverageTriangulation.envelope_findings/3` directly on a hand-built closure map with `binding_present?: true, closure_files: [], closure_mfas: ["Enum.map/2"]` and an `:aggregate` envelope with `mfas: []`) asserting `branch_guard_untested_realization` is emitted, tagged `@tag spec: ["specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity"]` with a matching `# covers:` comment (the id is already listed in the tagged_tests covers block at .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:434, so no `execute:` flip is needed).
  1c. ONLY if the team wants the user-visible behavior: change spec.triangle.ex:374-377 to render aggregate `branch_guard_untested_realization` findings as well, update the moduledoc (spec.triangle.ex:30-39) and requirement `specled.triangulation.spec_triangle_task`, then write the ticket's originally-prescribed test. This is a behavior + spec change, not polish — do not do it silently.

(2) .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md, requirement `specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity` (lines 244-256): extend the statement so the unloadable-module posture is explicit. End state: after "a compile source outside the repository root contributes no closure file", add that a closure module that fails `Code.ensure_loaded/1` likewise contributes no closure file, and that in both cases the requirement retains `binding_present?: true` from its closure MFAs — an unloadable or out-of-repo binding is a dangling-binding concern, not evidence of a missing test. Keep the existing final clause.

(3) .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:28-29: reword "The v1 functions and `mix spec.triangle` are unchanged" to past tense scoped to the v2 addition, e.g. "the v2 addition left the v1 functions and `mix spec.triangle` unchanged". Do not touch the trailing "only `mix spec.triangle` and `mix spec.review` may ever consume either path (Decision: never `mix spec.check`)" clause.

Gate after: `mix spec.check --no-run-commands` (+ `mix test test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs test/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation_test.exs` if a test is added).

== EVIDENCE ==
Nothing from this ticket has landed; the tree at feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors is byte-identical to main for every file b23 targets (`git diff --stat main..HEAD -- .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex` => empty output; last commit touching those paths is c13d1bdd, on main).

Item 3 (stale sentence) CONFIRMED present verbatim. .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:28-29: "`specled.triangulation.envelope_*` requirements below. The v1 functions and / `mix spec.triangle` are unchanged; only `mix spec.triangle` and `mix / spec.review` may ever consume either path". Contradicted as a standing claim by .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:244-256, which constrains `mix spec.triangle`'s v1 closure-file production by name.

Item 2 (unloadable-module posture) still unstated. Current statement, .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md:244-256: "Producers deriving closure files from module compile sources (`mix spec.triangle`, `Review.CoverageClosure`) shall emit them repository-root-relative; a compile source outside the repository root contributes no closure file. Such a requirement keeps `binding_present?: true` from its closure MFAs — an unresolvable file identity shall not collapse to a \"no binding\" verdict." The only named cause is out-of-repo compile source; the `Code.ensure_loaded/1` failure path is not mentioned. That path is real: lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:452-465 `mfa_source_file/1` returns `[]` on `_ -> []` when ensure_loaded fails, and lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:436 `binding_present?: req.closure_mfas != []` stays true.

Item 1 (test gap) — the GAP is real but the PRESCRIBED REMEDY IS NOT IMPLEMENTABLE AS WRITTEN. Gap confirmed: the only aggregate-envelope test in test/mix/tasks/spec_triangle_test.exs is at :217, and its envelope declares `mfas: [%{mfa: "SpecLedEx.Coverage.category_summary/3", covered: true}]` (:249), so `executed_mfa_count == 1` and the untested gate at lib/specled_ex/coverage_triangulation.ex:986 (`req.binding_present? and Map.get(req, :closure_mfas, []) != [] and ... executed_mfa_count == 0`) cannot fire. The out-of-repo test at :544 passes `--artifact-path .spec/_coverage/missing.coverdata` (:565-570), i.e. the missing-artifact leg only. Grep of the whole file for `binding_present|untested_realization` returns zero hits.
BUT: `mix spec.triangle` never renders `branch_guard_untested_realization`. lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:374-377 in the `:aggregate` clause does `|> CoverageTriangulation.envelope_findings(closure_map, tag_index) |> Enum.filter(&(&1["code"] == "detector_unavailable"))`. The task's other coverage legs never read `binding_present?` either: the non-degraded per_test leg calls `execution_reach_map/2` (spec.triangle.ex:341; coverage_triangulation.ex:154-159 does not read the field), the aggregate leg calls `aggregate_requirement_reach/2` (coverage_triangulation.ex:896-913, field unread), and the v1 `findings/3` untested gate (coverage_triangulation.ex:578-580) is `req.binding_present? and req.closure_files != []`, so an out-of-repo binding (closure_files == []) is excluded by the second conjunct regardless of `binding_present?`. There is no `--json`/findings output mode (OptionParser strict list, spec.triangle.ex:52-53: `root, spec_dir, artifact_path, all`). Consequence: `binding_present?` produced at spec.triangle.ex:436 has NO observable effect through `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle.run/1` today — which is exactly why ygi's Experiment C broke nothing on this producer.
Corollary falsehood in shipped source: the comment at lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:431-435 reads "MFA-based, not file-based: ... the MFA-level untested-realization gate reads this and must keep flagging it." No gate in this task's call graph reads it; the aggregate findings are filtered out at :376.

== RISK NOTES ==
1. PREMISE CORRECTION (must reach the orchestrator): ticket item 1's instruction — "Add an aggregate-envelope case to spec_triangle_test.exs with an out-of-repo-only binding asserting branch_guard_untested_realization still fires" — cannot be satisfied. `mix spec.triangle` filters aggregate envelope findings to `detector_unavailable` only (lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:376), so that finding is never rendered by the task under any flag. An implementer who takes the ticket literally will either write a test that cannot pass or silently change task behavior. See remaining_work 1a/1b/1c.

2. Realization-hash drift: .spec/realization_hashes.json tracks only `api_boundary`, and the sole triangulation entry is `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle.run/1` (hash ec7cf841…, hasher_version 1). run/1 spans spec.triangle.ex:47-78; the comment edit in 1a is at :431-435, far below it, so it should not shift run/1. api_boundary hashes here are line-position-sensitive, so do NOT insert or delete lines above line 47 of lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex; if that becomes unavoidable, the baseline entry must be regenerated deliberately and called out in the commit.

3. File-region conflict with specled_-dn4.12: that ticket consolidates the four byte-identical repo-relative source helpers, explicitly naming `Mix.Tasks.Spec.Triangle.repo_relative_source/1` (spec.triangle.ex:~468) and `Review.CoverageClosure.repo_relative_source/1`, plus `source_to_binary/1` in formatter.ex and coverage_triangulation.ex. b23's 1a comment edit sits ~30 lines above that helper in the same file, and dn4.12 may also update .spec/specs/triangulation.spec.md `surface:`/`realized_by:` blocks (lines 34-49) while b23 edits the `summary:` (line 28) and a requirement (244-256) in the same file. Different regions, same two files — sequence dn4.12 and b23 rather than landing them from independent worktrees, or land b23 first (it is prose + tests only).

4. Requirement id `specled.triangulation.v1_file_level_path_identity` is edited by this ticket and is referenced at three places in the spec (statement :244, scenario covers :393, tagged_tests covers :434). No other ticket in the set mentions triangulation (checked all 21 via bw show). No ordering dependency on any other ticket.

5. No `execute:` flag flips are needed; the id is already inside an `execute: true` tagged_tests block, so any new tagged test goes live immediately and will be run by the bare `mix spec.check` preflight.
